headline: 《玩具总动员5》领跑今日热搜
headlineEn: Toy Story 5 Leads Today's Hot Search
summary: 今日无新片上映，本周共5部新片。热搜由《玩具总动员5》《怒之杀》领衔，《绿灯军团》成周内最热，备受期待的《最后的日出》即将上映。
summaryEn: No new films released today; five new films hit this week. Toy Story 5 and Fury Kill lead daily trends, Green Lantern Corps tops the week, and highly anticipated The Last Sunrise is coming soon.

industryHighlights.text: 今日无新片上映，市场静待周末新片潮。
industryHighlights.en: No new films today; market awaits the weekend release wave.

industryHighlights.text: 本周共5部新片，动画与动作题材为主。
industryHighlights.en: Five new films this week, led by animation and action genres.

industryHighlights.text: 《绿灯军团》成为本周热度最高的影片。
industryHighlights.en: Green Lantern Corps is the hottest film of the week.

industryHighlights.text: 备受期待的《最后的日出》宣布即将上映。
industryHighlights.en: Highly anticipated The Last Sunrise announced for upcoming release.
